headline: Indonesia Faces Growing Economic Crisis Under Prabowo Policies
summary: President Prabowo Subianto’s economic policies have shaken investor confidence, plunging Indonesia into mounting economic hardship and hardship at home.
why: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy, where foreign direct investment and domestic stability are critical for regional market confidence.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Declining investor confidence and policy uncertainty threaten economic growth and domestic financial stability.
